simple-git-hooks.commit-msg: pnpm exec commitlint --edit "$1" || { echo; echo "The commit was stopped by the message check. Edit the message file and commit again:"; echo "  ${EDITOR:-vi} $1"; echo "  Use -F \"$1\" in place of the old message option (-m), and keep other options such as --amend."; exit 1; }
